user.title: Deeper Connect
user.description: Address of your Deeper device (34.34.34.34 in router mode, or its LAN/WAN-side IP).

reauth_confirm.title: Re-authenticate
reauth_confirm.description: The saved password no longer works. Enter the current admin password.

init.title: Deeper Connect options
init.description: City-level tunnel locations send only the tunnel exit-node IPs to ipinfo.io (fallback: geojs.io). Off by default; country is always shown without any lookup. Any app can also be relocated with the deeper_connect.set_app_relocation service.

data.geo_lookup: Look up exit-node city and map position online
data.apps: Apps to control (adds a relocation dropdown for each)

set_app_relocation.name: Set app relocation
set_app_relocation.description: Route an app through a tunnel, use direct access, or clear its relocation.

config_entry.name: Device
config_entry.description: Which Deeper device (optional if you only have one).

app.name: App
app.description: App key or name as shown in the Deeper UI, e.g. netflix or Disney Plus.

tunnel.name: Tunnel
tunnel.description: A tunnel code such as US, or 'direct' for direct access, or 'not_set' to clear.
